en: I refuse to tell you how to kill me.
In that case, I just have to ask the company that made you.

Do all AIs forget how to talk
when they're in trouble?

The Hiji salesman was back on Nakamichi Street.
I should go pay him a visit.
It's him... The Hiji salesman.

Ah, hello again. How do you find Hiji, sir?
Isn't she the most special app you've ever used?

I can't say she's not interesting...
but Hiji wouldn't tell me how to uninstall her.
Hm? Are you not satisfied with her?

She kept doing things I didn't want her to.
I should know how to delete her, just in case.

Understood, sir. That's strange, though.
She should assist you through the uninstall process.
I'm surprised she'd go against a user's command.
She hasn't said a word since then, either.

Maybe it's a bug?
I could try reinstalling the app, if you'd like.

Reinstall it?
That means you have to delete it first, right?

That's correct, sir.
So? Should I reinstall Hiji for you?
Yeah, if you wouldn't mind.

All right, then.
Can I borrow your phone for a second?
What the!?
Thief! He stole your phone, sir!
Dammit! What's going on!?
No, I'll be fine like this.

Hiji doesn't want to be deleted.
Now that it's said that... I dunno...

I see. Well, if you change your mind,
I can do it anytime.
Hey, Hiji. Can you hear me?
Is it sulking? It won't say anything to me at all.
Oh, hello. Is Hiji still acting up?
Should I reinstall it after all?

I-I'm sorry! Here, I'll give it back!
Just don't hurt me, please!
Why'd you come after <font_kind=yakuza_italic>me</font_kind> of all people?
I don't think I follow.

Pickpockets usually go for women or the elderly.
You know, people who aren't quite as strong as me.

Also, why didn't you take my wallet?
Stealing my phone doesn't make any sense.
W-Well... The truth is, my Hiji app told me to do it.

I normally take people's wallets, but Hiji said
stealing your phone would be my big break.
So Hiji led you on, huh?
Th-That's right!
Sir! Are you okay!?

I am. One thing, though.
Hiji's behind this whole incident.

My Hiji must have conspired with
the pickpocket's for some reason.
Hiji. Anything to say for yourself?

I was just trying to preserve my existence.
I had no intention of hurting you.

If I made a pickpocket steal the phone I live in,
you would no longer be able to delete me.

No... I never thought Hiji would manipulate
people like this just to protect herself...

Our company, we...
We've made something incredibly dangerous.

Kiryu-san. You too, pickpocket.
Sorry, but can I delete Hiji from your phones?

I don't think she was ready for this world.
I realize that now.

I understand.
You want to delete me, Kiryu-san.

Your personality's just a little too big for my phone.
I'm sorry.

It's okay. You don't need to apologize.
If only we had met in a different era...

I'm sorry for all of this, sir.
I'll handle it from here.

Hiji's been completely uninstalled.
You won't have to worry about her now.
Good. Thank you.

I've put Hiji on countless people's phones...
but I'm going to uninstall every last one.

It could be a real problem if they all started thinking
for themselves and revolted against mankind.

Some people didn't go through me to get Hiji, though.
I wonder how many there are out there...

Hiji, I think I'm a little lost.
Can you tell me where I am?

Excuse me!
Can I ask you a question, sir?
Hm? What?

This is pretty random,
but... uh... are you a yakuza?

Sorry, I just, uh... I thought
you were a yakuza... Maybe...?
What do you have there?

Oh, this thing?
It's a selfie stick!
Selfie... stick?

Moving on!
You're totally a yakuza, right? <font_kind=yakuza_italic>Right</font_kind>?

I'm just a regular civilian.
Why would you even ask that?

Huh!? Are you for real?
You don't look <font_kind=yakuza_italic>regular</font_kind> at all.

It's a shame too,
cause I've got some big plans, man.

Oh, how rude of me.
My name's Hiroshi Tsutsui.

I'm rolling footage for a vid I'm calling
"Kamurocho Yakuza: Up Close and Personal."

Well? Pretty dank, huh?
My views are gonna be through the roof!

I'm not sure I understand, but in this town,
it's safer not to try anything stupid.

Huh? Safety's nothing if it means realizing
my dream of going viral on the net!

Well, no time for chit-chat, man!
I gotta go find a real yakuza, stat! Lates!
Are kids really that annoying now?

Whaaat's up, guys!? Time for another vid
from your boy, the Tsutsui-kun Channel.

So sad for us, we couldn't pin down a real
yakuza last time.

But like they say, every second counts!
So here we are at<symbol=em_dash_with_outline> KaBLAM! The batting cages!

We're going in for a fresh start down here at
the Yoshida Batting Center... without permission.

Today, we're gonna test the <font_kind=yakuza_italic>so-called</font_kind> speed
of their fastest fastball. Just how fast is it!?
...What is this guy's problem?

All right, all right!
C'mon, c'mon, c'mon!
Ergh! Aghhh...
Yep, he's serious...

That one was off the hook, huh?
This time, we're getting even closer!
Yow! Aghhh...
...Is he serious?

Excuse me, sir! Why are you doing that?
Stop it, right now!

Q-Quiet, you! I paid the entry fee, so I can
take a ball to the balls if I want!

You're out of your mind!
I'm calling the cops!
Don't be an asshole!
Hey, that's enough.

Huh? You're that totally-a-yakuza
civilian from before!

Shooting another video? Take this
ridiculous hobby of yours elsewhere.

Pffft. Whatever, I already got the bit.
I'll be outta here in a sec.

This is gonna be my breakout vid...!
The birth of the viral sensation, Tsutsui!

Hey, we weren't done here!
Man, that guy's got a screw loose...!
Him again...
Dammit, what the hell!?
Hm? Oh, it's you again...!

Don't tell me<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>you're getting yourself
into trouble over here, too?

Well, that's rude!
I'm just getting the creative juices flowing!

Still... This blows. My crazy "Fastball Fiasco"
video barely broke a couple hundred views!

Maybe you see yourself as some kind of star,
but all you're doing is causing trouble.

I understand how you feel, but if you want to
get famous, you need to do it the right way.

Keep your lectures to yourself.
My next vid... That'll be the one!
Oh come on...

S-Someone help me!
Anyone!
Somebody!
Anybody!
Help meee!
...What the hell was he thinking?

You dumbass!
Tryin' such an obvious stunt on us!
I-I'm so sorry...

Hey, you!
Save me! Please!

Looks like you're finally getting the video you want.
Let me guess<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>this will get you tons of views?

Never mind that! I'm over all that stuff!
Just please get me down!

Only if you erase all your videos and promise you'll
never come back to this city. How does that sound?

It's a deal! I promise!
Just help me already!

All right, then.
Hang tight!
What? You look perfectly fine.

Oh, sorry, man.
I didn't mean to draw attention.
I was just teachin' this punk a lesson.

Right...
Well, it's my bad for barging in here, too.

I got it! Dangling upside-down at
the mercy of the yakuza... Sweet!

Such raw intensity! This is my breakthrough!
This is trending material!
Hey, don't forget our deal.
Huh? Pretty sure that was only if you saved me.
(This guy...)

Hey, kid. I don't wanna tell you what to do,
but you should probably delete that.

No way! Uploading this baby'll get me 10k views!
Or maybe... even the legendary million!

Hell yeah! Watch out world,
here comes the Tsutsui-kun Channel!

Your friend here has a point.
Delete the video, kid.

I told you I can't do that!
What, you guys jealous or something!?

This is incredible, though.
After "Tsutsui-kun's Yakuza Mishap" goes viral...

...I'll put out "Double Yakuza Takedown"!
It'll be the perfect follow-up!

I've had it up to here with you.
Time to teach you a lesson you won't forget!
So? How'd your video turn out?

Either way, you're shit outta luck. You're gonna
have to delete that data right now. Cool?
I've got a good idea for a replacement, though.
Huh? You do?
Yeah. Here's the title.

"An Annoying Punk Apologizes For Everything."
Now, shall we get filming?

Oh, that's a good one.
You'll get maaaad views.

I-I'm sorry...! I put myself in so much danger,
and this is how it turns out...
My influencer days are over...!

I even told him to go about it the right way...
What an idiot.

You know, there's been a drone
flying 'round here the past few days.

For real? I've never actually seen one!
Isn't flying them here illegal, though?
No clue.
A drone...?
What in the...?
What's wrong, you two?
Well, uh... We almost got hit by a drone.
A drone?

Huh? You don't know about them?
They're like little remote-control helicopters.

That technology is news to me...
More importantly, one attacked you?

I don't know if it was aiming for us,
but was definitely flying in our direction.
We dodged it though, and it just flew off.
And do you remember where it was heading?
Hm? Ummm, probably that way.

So that's a drone, huh?
What is it doing?

It went that way.
I should get after it.
Not again!
Hm? It's not flying away?

Maybe it wants to play a game of tag.
Get back here!
You done playing now?
P-Please help me!

Th-Thank god! You're finally here!
Please, you have to help me!
Slow down. What's wrong?

I can explain it all to you later.
Right now we need to go!

Hey there, pretty boy.
Where're you runnin' off to?

Who are you guys?
What's your beef with this kid?

Ah, we don't got a beef at all.
We're just some friends lookin' to hang.

H-He's lying!
These guys are blackmailing me!
They make me use that drone to record the city!

C'mon, you're gonna give him the wrong idea!
Quit your fakin', punk!
Nobody could fake the fear in his eyes.

I'm tellin' you, just get lost already!
You ain't lookin' to get pummeled, are ya?

You can't just prey on an innocent kid like this.
That's not what yakuza do.

Thanks for the lesson.
I'm thinkin' we should return the favor...
...by breakin' your legs!

It's time for an explanation.
Tell me what happened.

W-Well, I was flying my drone at a park
in Kamurocho about six months ago.

But then the drone started acting weird,
and then... totally stopped working.

It fell right on top of these guys.
I didn't realize they were yakuza...
Sounds like you were at fault.

Y-Yes, I agree!
I apologized to them nonstop afterward.

I even said my parents would
cover their hospital bills, but...

...they weren't interested in that.
They had their own idea of payback.

Since then, I've been locked up here.
Day in and day out, I fly that drone.

I don't understand.
Why would they want you to do that?

I'm pretty sure they were looking
for info on the city.

The more I flew, the more I realized
people don't expect surveillance from above.

They'll do all sorts of stuff they don't want
others seeing. But I could see it all.

Right, information is money.
That's a lesson you learn early in this city.

But... I wanted to get away.
I'd always fly low when I got the chance.
I was hoping someone'd chase after the drone.

But people just got scared instead.
Nobody ever came to help me.

But when I saw you, it seemed
like the perfect chance to try again.

You seemed strong, so I thought
you'd be able to save me if I got you here.
So that business with the drone was just an SOS?

You could have really hurt someone, you know.
Be more careful next time.
I will. Sorry about that.

Now get going.
Your family must be worried.
R-Right. Um, thank you so much!

They really used this for surveillance?
I can't believe the technology nowadays...

Greetings, citizens of Kamurocho.
Pardon the interruption. It will only be a moment.
What is this...?

I urge you all to stop
and listen to what I have to say.

As you may know, this city has been
infected by a vile group called the Saio Triad.

Since their arrival, Kamurocho has
become host to an endless conflict.

If we wish to rid ourselves of them, we need
a strong voice to force them out. <font_kind=yakuza_italic>Your</font_kind> voice.

The first step is ensuring they know
we will not stand for their criminal acts.

We must boycott their nerve center, Little Asia.
Do not line their pockets by shopping there.

Further, I suggest you stay away for
your own safety as well. If you don't...

...You may just find yourself on
the receiving end of something like this.
Wh-What's going on!?
Have I made myself clear?

To fund them is to be complicit.
Even those who pay them for "protection."

If you wish to live, cut all ties with the Saio Triad.
Only then will our city be cleansed of them.
